description.zh:
部署物类型。默认值为：AcrImage。可能的值：

- HelmChart：Helm Chart镜像。

- AcrImage：容器镜像。
description.en:
The type of the artifact. The default value is AcrImage. Valid values:

- HelmChart: a Helm chart image.

- AcrImage: a container image.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.
The token that is used to start the next query.
The name of the image repository.

title.zh: 查看已上传至ACR的镜像列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-acr-image-repositories --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU= --repo-name wordpress --artifact-type AcrImage --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier ListAcrImageRepositories --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU=' --ArtifactType AcrImage --MaxResults 20 --RepoName wordpress
